title: Luminous Operations CloudEvent Profile V1
description: A strict local profile of the CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON event format. Validity does not establish producer trust, authorization, freshness, tenant access, or permission to execute an action.

id.description: CloudEvents event ID; the pair source + id identifies a distinct event.

source.description: Stable URI-reference identifying the source context. It is not proof of authenticated identity.

type.description: Versioned reverse-DNS event type. Semantic changes require a new type or payload schema version.

subject.description: Resource identity in the source context, e.g. incident/incident-local-7301.

time.description: Optional CloudEvents occurrence time. Producer-reported time is not inherently trusted.

dataschema.description: Stable versioned URI identifying the exact schema for data.

tenantid.description: Luminous extension: canonical local tenant identity, resolved from authenticated connection context rather than trusted from an external payload.

idempotencykey.description: Luminous extension: stable source-operation key for business-effect deduplication. Enforce durably within authenticated connection + tenant scope.

observedat.description: Luminous extension: timestamp assigned by the first trusted ingestion boundary; preserve separately from time.

correlationid.description: Luminous extension: end-to-end workflow correlation identity.

causationref.description: Optional Luminous extension: canonical reference to the causal event. Omit for a root event; causal existence/cycle checks are consumer responsibilities.

producersystem.description: Luminous extension: normalized producer system label, not authentication material.

actorkind.description: Luminous extension: claimed initiating actor category; identity and authorization still require independent verification.

authorityref.description: Optional Luminous extension: reference to separately verifiable authorization evidence. This string is never an authorization grant.

data.description: Domain payload validated against dataschema. Must not include credentials, tokens, private keys, session secrets, or unredacted media.
